title: Select
description: A dropdown menu for displaying choices.
whenToUse:
- A dropdown menu for displaying choices - an elegant alternative to the native `<select>` element.
- Utilizing [Radio](/components/radio/) is recommended when there are fewer total options (less than 5).
- You probably need [AutoComplete](/components/auto-complete/) if you're looking for an input box that can be typed or selected.

examples.description: The height of the input field for the select defaults to 32px. If size is set to large, the height will be 40px, and if set to small, 24px.

examples.description: Coordinating the selection of provinces and cities is a common use case and demonstrates how selection can be coordinated. Cascader component is strongly recommended in this case.

examples.name: Get value of selected item
examples.description: As a default behavior, the `onChange` callback can only get the `value` of the selected item. The `labelInValue` prop can be used to get the `label` property of the selected item.

examples.description: Variants of Select, there are four variants: `outlined` `filled` `borderless` and `underlined`.

examples.name: Custom Selected Label Render
examples.description: Allows custom rendering of the currently selected label, which can be used for value backfill but the corresponding option is missing and does not want to directly render the value.

examples.name: Responsive maxTagCount
examples.description: Auto collapse to tag with responsive case. Not recommend use in large form case since responsive calculation has a perf cost.

examples.name: Big Data
examples.description: Select use virtual scroll which get better performance, turn off it by setting `virtual={false}`.

examples.name: Status
examples.description: Add status to Select with `status`, which could be `error` or `warning`.

examples.name: Placement
examples.description: You can manually specify the position of the popup via `placement`.

examples.name: Max Count
examples.description: You can set the `maxCount` prop to control the max number of items can be selected. When the limit is exceeded, the options will become disabled.

examples.name: Custom semantic dom styling
examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of Select by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.
